Ordered workflow tabs (the kitsUI style)

Source: R/tabs.R
kit_flow_tabs.Rd

A regular shiny::tabsetPanel() with circled numbers in the tab names (① 資料, ② 題目校準…; "Data", "Item calibration"). Tabs that are not a workflow step (e.g. "使用手冊", "User manual") go in aside: dashed border, no shadow, pushed to the far right. Done tabs get a ✓ (an extra .kit-tab-mark in the tab); tabs that can't be used yet are gray (kit_send_tab_states()).

Usage

kit_flow_tabs(..., id = "tabs", selected = NULL, aside = NULL)

Arguments

...

shiny::tabPanel().

id

The tabsetPanel id (input[[id]] is the current tab).

selected

The tab to start on (value).

aside

Values of tabs that are not a workflow step (a character vector).

Value

<div class="kit-flow-tabs"> containing a tabsetPanel().

Examples

kit_flow_tabs(
  shiny::tabPanel("① 資料", value = "data"),
  shiny::tabPanel("② 題目校準", value = "items"),
  shiny::tabPanel("使用手冊", value = "manual"),
  id = "flow", aside = "manual"
)
#> <div class="kit-flow-tabs" data-kit-aside="manual">
#>   <div class="tabbable">
#>     <ul class="nav nav-tabs shiny-tab-input" id="flow" data-tabsetid="1261">
#>       <li class="active">
#>         <a href="#tab-1261-1" data-toggle="tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-value="data">① 資料</a>
#>       </li>
#>       <li>
#>         <a href="#tab-1261-2" data-toggle="tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-value="items">② 題目校準</a>
#>       </li>
#>       <li>
#>         <a href="#tab-1261-3" data-toggle="tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" data-value="manual">使用手冊</a>
#>       </li>
#>     </ul>
#>     <div class="tab-content" data-tabsetid="1261">
#>       <div class="tab-pane active" data-value="data" id="tab-1261-1"></div>
#>       <div class="tab-pane" data-value="items" id="tab-1261-2"></div>
#>       <div class="tab-pane" data-value="manual" id="tab-1261-3"></div>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
